metaDescription: Order durable custom aluminum luggage ID tags for bulk branding. Perfect for corporate gifts and travel. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Aluminum luggage ID tags offer a sleek, professional look that withstands the rigors of frequent travel. Unlike plastic or leather, aluminum resists scuffs and bending, keeping your brand visible trip after trip. These tags are ideal for corporate travel gifts or employee recognition programs. With options for laser engraving or full-color printing, your logo stays crisp and clear. Choose from brushed or polished finishes to match your company's aesthetic.
